criteria.text: Durable positive integer revisions strictly increase per (kind,id) for completed, updated and retracted events, including hard deletion and recreation.
Answerable lessons, text, documents and title changes emit a full UPDATED package with one event per logical edit; service-only fields and deletion cascades do not create event storms.

Emit exact content-free v2 tombstones for deleted, unpublished, visibility_restricted and generation_reverted; publication or visibility withdrawal only when the last producer-organization member loses read access, as explicitly clarified by the owner.

Current manifests include every completed object readable by at least one producer-organization member under actual existing access rules, exactly once, in pages of at most 1000, hourly and after every reconciler run on the existing HMAC route.
Last-page resend requests enqueue only current objects with their current revision without allocating a new revision; scheduled reconciliation applies repairs with apply:true.

Exact HELIXA_KNOWLEDGE_SYNC_CONTRACT_V2=true is required; disabled v2 preserves v1 behavior through off/on/off transitions and immutable protocol-pinned retries. Activation awaits owner confirmation that Helixa v2 is live.

Every behavior change has a red control; root focused unit and disposable PostgreSQL proof, pnpm type-check and pnpm build pass; Russian outcome and activation report, no customer-data/secret output or source writes in Helixa.
